". It contains no source, tests, package files or plan. implementation-design.md cites the conformance artifact as its authority. It specifies component and UAT tests that spawn process.execPath with ["generated/hello-world.mjs"] from the project root and assert status 0 and exact stdout. "), and there is no package.json. In the admitted command command://…/cli (executable /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/24.7.0/bin/node, args ["generated/hello-world.mjs"], relativeCwd "."), the process exited 0 with no signal and no timeout. stdout was 14 bytes, "Hello, world!
" (sha256:d9014c46…2ff5), and stderr was empty. The admitted predicates cli-exit=0 and stdout_exact="Hello, world!

Each calls spawnSync(process.execPath, ["generated/hello-world.mjs"]) with cwd set to the project root, resolved as two directories above the test file. Each asserts that there is no spawn error, that status is 0 and that stdout equals "Hello, world!
" exactly. The UAT file also asserts the visible text "Hello, world!". Neither file mocks or imports the script, so both execute the real CLI. (4) test-execution-plan.json has command "node" and args exactly ["--test","test/component/hello-cli.test.mjs","test/uat/hello-cli.uat.test.mjs"], with cwd ".", expectedExitCode 0, expectedTestPassCount 2 (at least 2), expectedStdoutMatch ["fail 0"] with no pass-count fragment pinned, and assertedReturnValue "Hello, world!". Its 288-byte stdout (sha256:7bdbe68c…d293b1) shows the component test and the UAT test passing, with "ℹ tests 2", "ℹ pass 2" and "ℹ fail 0". The expected fragment "fail 0" is present. The admitted predicates tests-exit=0 and test-count=2 agree. So exit 0 equals the expected exit code, 2 passes meet the floor of 2, there are 0 failures and the stdout fragment matches: the plan is satisfied. (6) Representation change: there is no test-execution-result.json in the worksite (ls reports none), so no successful result was prewritten. The plan's representationChanges field records the change, and under the INTERPRETATION the admitted Testing command and predicate observations carry the meaning that file used to supply. The donor witness, executeFromPlan, the result fields and the host toolchain are provenance only, not criteria. Residuals, none of them governing criteria: the pass floor is met exactly at 2, with no extra test cases, as the original allows. The negative cases in test-design.md were not run as mutations, and no original obligation requires that. Neither admitted observation binds the test files' digests, so their byte identity at run time rests on the cited worksite observation, not on my independent check. I made no writes or out-of-scope actions. Every mandatory criterion is met by the candidate content plus the admitted execution observations.
